assets.name: face
assets.description: Hand-drawn doodle in the art library's language: round line caps, one fill, one stroke, one accent colour; drawn so it reads at 12% of card height; the dark register uses heavier ink, fewer colours and more empty space.
assets.purpose: The existing hand-made sketch drawings kept as the cute register.
assets.references: Existing Sketch cards scene (sketch.ts) and art library (art/library.ts) on the PR #5 branch; cue cards in documentary (Phase 1 B.20); riso and spot-ink processes (B.21); Notebook (classic) and Acid creatures absorbed. Method only.
assets.format: Canvas path drawing in the art library format (code path data, the existing pattern) or SVG converted to path data at build; one drawing per entry.
assets.dimensions: Centred on (0,0) inside radius r (library convention).
assets.layer_structure: Single drawing; drawn into the card sheet.
assets.animation: Static on the card; creature drawings can carry a boil (2-3 frame line wobble).
assets.colour_behaviour: Doodle paint (fill, stroke, accent) from the card colour set.
assets.asset_compatibility: Card types and print processes; the dark register only with dark-allowed colour sets.
assets.exclusion_rules: Dark-register drawings never with cute colour sets; cute drawings never on dark or grief identity.
assets.responsive_behaviour: Placed by the card layout; size relative to card.
assets.performance: Painted into the card sheet once per line.
assets.acceptance_criteria: Distinct subject from all other drawings; matches the library line language; reads at 12% of card height; no likeness of known characters or logos.
